Renowned for its commitment to innovation, Altera's FPGA solutions offer unparalleled flexibility for customizing digital circuits to meet specific application needs. text_11.text: Altera provides a complete suite of development tools for every stage of an FPGA, SoC, or CPLD design. This includes core FPGA design software, simulation, embedded development tools, utilities for power and high-speed links, plus higher-level flows for acceleration and AI.

text_12.text:
Quartus Prime Design Software is the primary environment for designing FPGAs, SoC FPGAs, and CPLDs, including IP integration, compile, timing closure, and programming.

Platform Designer inside Quartus Prime is used for system integration, automatically generating interconnect logic to connect IP functions and subsystems.

Best for:

  • RTL and IP-based design flows
  • System integration using Platform Designer
  • Build, timing analysis, and device programming

title.jcr:title: Altera Agilex FPGA & SoC Portfolio | Agilex 3, 5 & 9 Series

text_intro.text: Explore the Altera Agilex SoC & FPGA family, including Agilex 3, 5, and 9 series: offering advanced performance. Find Altera development kits and support tools.

text_1.text: The Agilex® 3 FPGA is designed to deliver a blend of low power consumption, high performance, and small form factors, catering to various applications. This series stands out for its ease of use, making it an attractive option for designers familiar with Cyclone and MAX FPGAs. The Agilex 3 family includes B-Series and C-Series devices, each tailored for specific use cases. B-Series FPGAs are ideal for board-, platform-, and system-level management applications, such as power sequencing and system monitoring, whereas C-Series devices are designed to meet the broader and more demanding needs of industrial, medical, data center, and telecommunication applications. This range allows for versatile deployment in environments that require the latest in FPGA architecture, with a focus on AI capabilities in compact and power-efficient packages.

text_2.text: Altera Agilex 5 FPGAs offer enhanced performance and power efficiency, featuring industry-first AI Tensor Blocks, Arm Cortex-A76/A55 cores, and second-gen Hyperflex FPGA Architecture. They provide up to 2.5X performance and 50% lower power compared to Cyclone V FPGAs. With transceivers up to 28.1 Gbps, PCIe 4.0 x8, and DDR5 support, they cater to midrange FPGA applications in various markets like communication, video, industry, medical, data centers, and defense.

title.jcr:title: Altera Agilex 5 FPGA and SoC Overview

text_intro.text: Altera Agilex 5 FPGA and SoC with AI Tensor Block for edge AI and mid-range performance. Compare E-Series and D-Series FPGA options at Macnica Americas.

text_1.text: Altera Agilex 5 devices serve a broad range of applications that require high performance, lower power, and smaller form factors. This tier consists of the performance-optimized D-Series FPGAs and the power-optimized E-Series FPGAs. Altera Agilex 5 devices also feature the industry’s first Enhanced DSP with AI Tensor Block, which deliver high-efficiency AI and digital signal processing (DSP) functionality, and the FPGA industry’s first asymmetric applications processor system consisting of dual Arm Cortex-A76 cores and dual Cortex-A55 cores, which enable you to optimize the performance and power efficiency of their workloads. These characteristics make them ideal for midrange FPGA applications across the edge and core including wireless and wireline communications, video and broadcast equipment, industrial applications, test and measurement products, medical electronics, and defense applications.

table_1.text:
E-Series FPGAs and SoCs D-Series FPGAs and SoCs
E-Series FPGAs and SoCs are optimized for power and size - with 50% lower power while delivering up to 2.5X better performance as compared to Cyclone V devices, also with features including transceiver rates up to 24x28 Gbps, PCIe 4.0x4, 6x25GbE, 3,600 Mbps DDR5, dual core of A55 and dual core of A76 make it ideal for intelligent applications at the edge, embedded, and more. D-Series FPGAs and SoCs are optimized for performance and power efficiency - with 42% lower power while delivering up to 1.5X better performance as compared to Stratix 10 FPGAs, also with features including transceiver rates up to 32x28 Gbps, PCIe 4.0x8, 16x25GbE, 4,000 Mbps DDR5, dual core of A55 and dual core of A76 make it ideal for various applications across multiple markets.

text_2.text:
What is the difference between Agilex 5 E-Series and D-Series?

E-Series is optimized for power and size: 50% lower power and up to 2.5× better performance than Cyclone V, transceivers to 24×28 Gbps, and PCIe 4.0 x4. D-Series is optimized for performance: 42% lower power and up to 1.5× better performance than Stratix 10, transceivers to 32×28 Gbps, and PCIe 4.0 x8.

What is the AI Tensor Block in Agilex 5?

Agilex 5 includes an Enhanced DSP with AI Tensor Block for high-efficiency AI and DSP. Peak INT8 throughput reaches 25.99 TOPS on the E-Series A5E 065A and 56.22 TOPS on the D-Series A5D 064, with variable-precision DSP blocks.

What processors are in the Agilex 5 hard processor system?

The SoC uses an asymmetric applications processor: dual Arm Cortex-A76 cores up to 1.8 GHz and dual Cortex-A55 cores up to 1.5 GHz, with up to 2 MB shared L3 cache. That pairing balances performance and power by workload.

Which memory and interface standards does Agilex 5 support?

DDR5 to 4,000 Mbps on D-Series and 3,600 Mbps on E-Series, plus DDR4, LPDDR4, and LPDDR5. Connectivity includes PCIe 4.0, up to 6×25GbE on E-Series and 16×25GbE on D-Series, MIPI D-PHY, LVDS at 1.6 Gbps, and TSN.

What applications is the Agilex 5 mid-range FPGA aimed at?

Midrange edge and core designs: wireless and wireline communications, video and broadcast, industrial, test and measurement, medical electronics, and defense. Named focus markets are image sensor processing, autonomous mobile robots, and clinical systems, including battery-powered clinical equipment.

title.jcr:title: Altera Agilex 7 FPGA and SoC Overview

text_intro.text: Macnica Americas provides an in-depth overview of the Altera Agilex 7 FPGA & SoC capabilities. Discover the possibilities that this solution brings to your designs.

text_1.text: The Altera Agilex 7 devices include the industry’s highest performance FPGAs providing a range of premium features for the most demanding applications, including the F-Series, I-Series, and M-Series. This tier offers the industry’s highest data rate transceivers - up to 116 Gbps - the first PCIe 5.0 and CXL support, and options to integrate in-package HBM2E memory delivering the industry’s highest memory bandwidth (over 1 TBps). These capabilities enable customized connectivity and acceleration for the most compute, bandwidth, and memory-intensive use cases in communications, data center, defense, high-performance computing, video, high-end test/measurement/medical, and more.

table_1.text:
F-Series FPGAs and SoCs I-Series FPGAs and SoCs M-Series FPGAs and SoCs
F-Series devices are general purpose FPGAs built on Altera 10 nm SuperFin process technology. With features including transceiver rates up to 58 Gbps, advanced digital signal processing (DSP) blocks supporting multiple precisions of fixed-point and floating-point operations. I-Series devices offer the highest performance I/O interfaces to address bandwidth-intensive applications. Manufactured on Altera 10 nm SuperFin process technology, this series builds upon the F-Series device features offering transceiver rates up to 116 Gbps, PCIe 5.0 support, and cache- and memory-coherent attach to processors with CXL. M-Series devices are optimized for compute and memory-intensive applications. Leveraging Altera 7 process technology, this series builds upon I-Series device features offering an extensive memory hierarchy including integrated high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and high-efficiency interfaces

title.jcr:title: Altera Agilex 9 FPGA and SoC | Agilex 9 Performance Overview

text_intro.text: Discover the advanced features of Altera Agilex 9 FPGAs and SoCs. Learn how Agilex 9 offers next-generation performance for data-centric applications.

text_1.text:
Altera Agilex 9 FPGA and SoC is an FPGA with some enhanced functions for special applications. For example, the Direct RF Series​ ​integrates industry-leading wideband data converters with sample rates up to 64Gsps and mid-band data converters with high-fidelity performance into the FPGA. Ideal for applications such as defense, radar, high-end test, and wireless solutions. Targets those applications that demand ultra-low power consumption yet require high channel density packages to address difficult size constraints. Pushing beyond the limits of mainstream programmable logic - these FPGAs provide unprecedented capabilities and optimization for their target applications.

The Direct RF Series is optimized for synthesis of complex digital, mixed-signal and DSP algorithms. Synchronous products with up to 64Gsps sample rate are available in chiplet based configurations - providing a common front-end, flexible compute, connectivity and frequency agility.

  • Digital signal processing (DSP) performance (FP16)

text_4.text: • Enables design optimization capabilities to deliver significant fmax performance compared to previous generation high-end Altera FPGAs

text_intro.text: Explore Altera® Arria® 10 FPGAs & SoCs, delivering high performance & low power consumption for advanced applications. Learn more at Macnica Americas.

text_1.text: The Altera Arria 10 FPGAs and SoCs offer exceptional performance at 20 nm, surpassing competing products by a full-speed grade. They also consume up to 40% less power than previous-gen FPGAs and SoCs, and feature the industry's unique hard floating-point DSP blocks that can reach speeds of 1,500 giga floating-point operations per second (GFLOPS). These advanced Altera Arria 10 devices are well-suited for a broad spectrum of end-market applications.

title.jcr:title: Altera® Cyclone® 10 FPGAs | Intel Cyclone 10 Solutions

text_intro.text: Explore the power of Altera Cyclone 10 FPGAs with cutting-edge technology. Elevate your projects with groundbreaking innovation. Contact us for more info!

text_1.text:
Altera Cyclone 10 is a family of field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) offering a low-power, cost-effective solution for various applications. The Cyclone 10 family includes two device families, Cyclone 10 LP, and Cyclone 10 GX, each optimized for different use cases.

The Cyclone 10 LP family is designed for low-power, cost-sensitive applications that require a balance of power and bandwidth. It features up to 220K logic elements, 6.4 Gbps transceivers, and 1,600 Mbps DDR3 memory support. It also offers integrated intellectual property (IP) such as ARM Cortex-M1 processor, analog-to-digital converter (ADC), and digital signal processing (DSP) blocks.

The Cyclone 10 GX family is optimized for high-performance applications that require higher bandwidth. It features up to 220K logic elements, 12.5 Gbps transceivers, and 2,666 Mbps DDR4 memory support. Altera Cyclone 10 also offers advanced processing capabilities with up to two ARM Cortex-A9 processors, hard floating-point DSP blocks, and a range of configurable I/O standards.

Overall, Altera Cyclone 10 FPGAs offer a versatile and flexible solution for various applications such as industrial automation, smart vision, and automotive. They provide low-power, cost-effective, and high-performance options that can be customized to meet specific requirements.

text_intro.text: Altera FPGAs connect high speed sensors to NVIDIA GPU compute for real time edge AI. See our Holoscan Sensor Bridge reference designs and available dev kits.

text_1.text:
Edge AI Sensor Aggregation Built for the Camera to GPU Pipeline

Modern edge AI vision systems demand more than compute power. Before an AI model can process a single frame, that frame has to get from sensor to GPU with minimal latency and zero data loss. Altera FPGAs solve this sensor aggregation challenge, pairing scalable I/O flexibility with deterministic, low latency streaming to feed NVIDIA's Holoscan platform.

Altera's FPGA based Edge AI sensor solutions combine scalable compute performance, PQC enabled security, and low latency deterministic AI inferencing for real time edge applications. Flexible I/O aggregates audio, video, SoC, and other interfaces for pre processing within the FPGA, then streams to external compute such as GPU or CPU.

Macnica Americas offers the Altera Agilex 5 development kits used in Altera's own Holoscan Sensor Bridge reference designs, giving your team a direct path from evaluation to production.

heading_2.jcr:title: Why Altera FPGAs for Edge AI Sensor Bridging

text_2.text:
Scalable Performance Spectrum

Altera FPGAs span a broad range of features and performance, enabling Edge AI sensor bridge solutions from 1 to 400 Gbps. Whether the application calls for a single camera or a dense multi sensor array, there is an Agilex or Stratix device sized to fit.

Universal Sensor Interface Support

Altera FPGAs support the sensor interfaces Edge AI applications actually use in the field, including MIPI, JESD204, LVDS, SPI, CAN, HDMI, SDI, I2C, GPIO, and SLVS-EC. One FPGA platform, many sensor and video interface types.

Field Upgradeable Flexibility

Unlike fixed function ASIC, ASSP, or microcontroller based sensor bridges, an FPGA is field upgradeable. Hardware and software changes remain possible after deployment, protecting your investment as sensor requirements evolve.

text_3.text:
Holoscan Sensor Bridge is built to serve any application where high bandwidth sensor data needs to reach GPU compute with minimal latency. Common deployments include:

 

Robotics & Sensor Fusion

Processes data from multiple sensor types, including lidar and radar, in real time, integrating seamlessly with FPGA-based I/O.

Live Media Production

Connects live, high-speed camera feeds with AI, enabling software-defined production switching and analysis. A natural fit alongside SMPTE ST 2110 IP-based production workflows.

Industrial Inspection

Enables real-time defect detection on production lines and continuous quality monitoring.

Medical Imaging

Supports AI-enabled medical devices, assisting with surgical visualization, body pose estimation, and real-time image processing such as enhanced endoscopy feeds.

Radar Signal Processing

Accelerates real-time radar data pipelines, including FFT-based processing.

6G & Software-Defined Radio

Connects analog sensors to GPU compute for efficient, low-latency signal processing.

text_8.text: Pairing GPU and FPGA delivers what neither can achieve alone: low latency, rich AI features, high performance, and broad camera compatibility across industrial, retail, medical, and other demanding use cases. It acts as a Smart I/O Engine, splitting responsibilities between GPU, CPU, and FPGA so each does what it does best.

text_intro.text: Explore the versatile Multi-Rail Power Sequencer & Monitor designed for MAX 10 FPGA. Customize your sequencing needs with advanced features.

text_1.text: The Multi-Rail Power Sequencer and Monitor is a highly parameterizable set of IP blocks that can be customized to meet your power sequencing needs.  It controls the enable sequence of up to 143 output rails, can be distributed across multiple MAX® 10 devices to increase the number of monitored channels, and can draw from a mixture of Power Good (POK) inputs as well as monitored voltage rails. The sequencing can be based on voltages reaching a certain threshold as well as timed events, it offers parameterizable levels of glitch filtering on POK or voltage inputs, customizable retry responses, a comprehensive PMBus interface, and numerous other options to tailor the power sequencer to the needs of your application.

text_intro.text: Unlock the power of Altera Quartus Prime Design Software for creating, verifying, and programming FPGAs. This tool offers advanced debugging features.

text_1.text:
The Altera Quartus Prime Design Software is a powerful tool suite used to design, verify, and program FPGAs. It provides a comprehensive set of features for creating FPGA designs, including synthesis, simulation, timing analysis, place and route, and programming. The software also includes several advanced features, such as support for SystemVerilog and VHDL languages, advanced debugging tools, and the ability to interface with other design tools and IP cores.

The Altera Quartus Prime Design Software is designed to work with a wide range of Altera FPGA devices, from low-cost, low-power devices to high-performance devices with multi-gigabit transceivers. It includes a rich library of pre-designed IP blocks that can be used to quickly create complex designs, as well as support for third-party IP cores.

The software also includes several optimization features that can be used to improve design performance, reduce power consumption, and minimize design size. These optimization features include advanced synthesis and place-and-route algorithms, power analysis tools, and support for incremental design changes.

Overall, the Altera Quartus Prime Design Software is a powerful and flexible tool suite that provides designers with everything they need to create high-performance, low-power FPGA designs.

text_intro.text: Experience the Altera® Stratix 10 MX FPGA, a versatile accelerator critical for high-performance computing, data centers, NFV, and broadcast applications.

text_1.text: The Altera® Stratix 10 MX FPGA is a versatile accelerator that plays a critical role in high-performance computing (HPC), data centers, virtual networking functions (NFV), and broadcast applications. These FPGA accelerators are uniquely designed by combining the programmability and flexibility of Altera® Stratix® 10 FPGA and SoC FPGA with 3D stacked high-bandwidth memory 2 (HBM2). The innovative Altera® Hyperflex™ FPGA Architecture empowers the core fabric with exceptional performance and enables efficient utilization of bandwidth from the in-package memory tile. Moreover, the DRAM memory tile is physically connected to the FPGA using Altera’s Embedded Multi-Die Interconnect Bridge (EMIB) technology.

title.jcr:title: Ambarella Products: SoCs, CPUs, Chipsets, and More

text_intro.text: Ambarella SoCs and CVflow AI processors for edge AI, ADAS, robotics, and security cameras. Explore low-power computer vision solutions from Macnica today.

text_1.text: Ambarella’s technologies make cameras smarter - enabling features like person detection, object classification, analytics, and more - performing complex data analysis in real time, delivering breathtaking imagery, and preserving vital system resources such as power and network bandwidth. Ambarella specializes in the development of deployable, scalable designs for intelligent cameras, offering a proven path to mass production. Check out our Ambarella products, SoCs, CPUs, chipsets, and more.

text_2.text:
What is Ambarella CVflow architecture?

CVflow is Ambarella’s computer vision chip architecture. Unlike a general-purpose CPU or GPU, it uses a dedicated vision processing engine programmed with a high-level algorithm description. That design scales performance to trillions of operations per second at very low power.

Which neural network frameworks do Ambarella SoCs support?

Customers map CNNs trained with industry-standard tools such as Caffe, TensorFlow, and PyTorch onto Ambarella processors. The CNN toolkit also covers ONNX. Detection, classification, and related CNN/DNN tasks run on-chip.

Which Ambarella SoCs are used for ADAS?

CV2FS is for front-facing stereovision ADAS cameras and computer-vision ECUs at L2+ and higher, with CVflow AI and ASIL C compliance. CV22FS targets forward-facing monocular ADAS cameras and similar ECUs, also with ASIL C. Ambarella uses ISO 26262 processes for functional safety–certified products used in ADAS and autonomous driving.

What makes Ambarella a low-power edge AI SoC choice?

The SoCs and CPUs are built for embedded edge platforms such as battery-powered cameras. They can outperform competing solutions on power efficiency, sometimes by 5× or more, while matching or beating results. Compression also cuts bandwidth and storage.

What does stereovision add for robotics?

Stereo processing turns a 2D view into a 3D scene and can detect generic obstacles the system was not trained to recognize. CV2 is positioned for accurate 3D environmental modeling, real-time neural network performance, advanced robotics, and industrial autonomous robots.

heading_1.jcr:title: Ambarella N1 Family - Edge GenAI Is Here

text_3.text:
Ambarella’s N1 family of Edge GenAI SoCs delivers the processing power needed to run multimodal large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), and traditional CNN networks locally, without cloud dependency. Designed for autonomous mobile robots, on-premise AI boxes, smart city security, industrial automation, and intelligent healthcare, the N1 series sets a new benchmark for AI performance per watt at the edge.

As an authorized Ambarella distributor and value-added engineering partner, Macnica Americas provides component supply, design-in support, and technical consulting to help you bring your next N1-based design to production.

text_4.text:
CVflow® Chip Architecture

Ambarella CVflow® chip architecture is based on a deep understanding of core computer vision algorithms. Unlike general-purpose CPUs and GPUs, CVflow includes a dedicated vision processing engine programmed with a high-level algorithm description, allowing Ambarella architecture to scale performance to trillions of operations per second with extremely low power consumption.

With CVflow, customers can efficiently map their own CNN networks trained with industry-standard tools (e.g., Caffe, TensorFlow, PyTorch) to run on Ambarella processors.

text_5.text:
Stereovision

Stereo processing transforms the world from a flat 2D plane into a full 3D environment. This not only provides a richer, denser representation of the target scene, but also allows the detection of generic obstacles that the system hasn’t been trained to recognize, making navigation safer and more effective for warehouse robots, autonomous vehicles, and more.

text_6.text:
Low Power

Ambarella technology products are designed to be deployed in embedded platforms on the edge (e.g., battery-powered cameras), where power consumption is a critical concern. Ambarella SoCs and CPUs consistently outperform competitive solutions in power efficiency - sometimes by 5x or more - while delivering equal or superior results.

text_7.text:
Reduce Bandwidth & Storage Costs

Ambarella compression technologies dramatically reduce data transmission size, slashing storage costs and bandwidth usage with Ambarella products.

text_8.text:
Image Quality

One of the hallmarks of Ambarella processors is our image processing pipeline. Encompassing everything from HDR to EIS to dewarping, our state-of-the-art ISP ensures that every frame of every video is exquisite, improving safety and enhancing the viewing experience.

text_9.text:
Autonomy

From drones to robots, from taxis to long-haul semi trucks, Ambarella’s vision processors were designed to revolutionize the way we work and travel. Our hardware platforms deliver the flexibility required to implement all levels of automation, including partial, conditional, high, and full autonomy.

text_10.text:
Functional Safety

As an AI silicon company offering SoCs for applications such as ADAS and autonomous driving, Ambarella has implemented an array of internal processes and procedures to ensure that their functional safety-certified products comply with ISO 26262. These strict processes and procedures touch every aspect of the work Ambarella does - from technical documentation to software engineering to VLSI - and have become an inextricable part of Ambarella culture, from top to bottom.

text_intro.text: Macnica Americas presents the Ambarella CV72S SoC. Dive into a new era of advanced computer vision solutions, tailored for cutting-edge visual applications.

heading_1.jcr:title: 4K, 5nm Edge AI SoC for mainstream security cameras

text_1.text: Ambarella has announced the launch of its new CV72S System-on-Chip (SoC) which offers a powerful solution for next-generation smart cameras. The CV72S SoC delivers advanced computer vision capabilities that enable smart cameras to process ultra-high-definition video, high dynamic range imaging, and advanced deep learning features, making it ideal for a range of applications, including security, autonomous vehicles, and robotics.

text_2.text:
One of the key technical features of the Ambrella CV72S is its ability to process 8K video at 30 frames per second or 4K video at 120 frames per second. This high level of processing power is achieved through a custom-designed quad-core Arm Cortex-A72 CPU that delivers high-performance computing at low power consumption.

In addition to its processing capabilities, the Ambrella CV72S integrates a range of advanced image processing features, including multi-exposure high dynamic range (HDR) tone mapping, advanced noise reduction, and color management. These features enable the SoC to deliver superior image quality in challenging lighting conditions, such as in outdoor surveillance applications.

The Ambrella CV72S also includes hardware support for advanced deep-learning features such as object detection, tracking, and classification. The SoC includes a powerful neural network accelerator that can execute convolutional neural network (CNN) models with high throughput and low latency. This makes the CV72S ideal for a wide range of applications that require advanced computer vision capabilities.

The Ambrella CV72S interfaces with a variety of industry-standard interfaces and protocols, making it easy for developers to integrate the SoC into their existing hardware designs. The SoC includes support for Gigabit Ethernet, USB 3.0, and PCIe interfaces, as well as support for popular deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and Caffe.

In conclusion, the Ambarella CV72S SoC is a highly advanced computer vision solution for smart camera systems that offers a powerful combination of ultra-high-definition video processing, high dynamic range imaging, and advanced deep learning features. With its custom-designed quad-core Arm Cortex-A72 CPU, powerful neural network accelerator, and support for industry-standard interfaces and protocols, the CV72S is an ideal choice for developers and manufacturers of smart camera systems.

Cloud-based AI inference is facing real headwinds: bandwidth costs, ongoing service fees, latency constraints, data privacy regulations, and connectivity limitations in the field. The Ambarella N1 family is purpose-built for the shift toward edge-native AI, where the intelligence lives in the device rather than in a remote data center.

Ambarella’s CVflow® architecture and fine-tuning techniques, including QLoRA-based model compression, make it possible to run production-grade GenAI models in power-and-cost-constrained enclosures. The result is a new class of intelligent edge device that responds faster, costs less to operate, and is more secure by design.

text_11.text: The N1-655’s combination of multi-channel video decode, VLM support, and sub-20W power envelope makes it well suited for AMRs that need to interpret complex environments, respond to natural language commands, and operate continuously without a cloud connection.

text_12.text: From AI visual inspection to collaborative robots on the production line, the N1 family supports the multi-sensor, real-time processing that modern manufacturing requires. Both SoCs integrate naturally into AIoT architectures where data stays on the factory floor.

text_13.text: Process multiple camera feeds simultaneously, run object detection, classification, and tracking alongside VLM-based scene understanding, all within a single manageable power budget. Eliminate recurring cloud processing costs for large-scale deployments.

text_14.text: For enterprises that cannot or will not send sensitive video and sensor data to the cloud, the N1 family enables full-featured GenAI inference to run locally in a standard rack, an industrial enclosure, or an edge appliance.

text_15.text: High-resolution imaging, real-time diagnostics support, and patient data that never leaves the facility. The N1’s processing depth and sensor fusion capabilities address the demanding requirements of edge medical AI.

title.jcr:title: Analog Devices ADPD4100 & ADPD4101 Multimodal Sensors

text_intro.text: The ADPD4100 & ADPD4101 multimodal sensors are designed for advanced biometric sensing applications. Contact our sales team today & request a quote.

text_1.text:
The ADPD4100/ADPD4101 operate as a complete multimodal sensor front end, stimulating up to eight light-emitting diodes (LEDs) and measuring the return signal on up to eight separate current inputs. Twelve time slots are available, enabling 12 separate measurements per sampling period.

The data output and functional configuration utilize an I2C interface on the ADPD4101 or a serial port interface (SPI) on the ADPD4100. The control circuitry includes flexible LED signaling and synchronous detection. The devices use a 1.8 V analog core and 1.8 V/3.3 V compatible digital input/output (I/O).

text_2.text:
The analog front end (AFE) rejects signal offsets and corruption from asynchronous modulated interference, typically from ambient light, eliminating the need for optical filters or externally controlled dc cancellation circuitry. Multiple operating modes are provided, enabling the ADPD4100/ADPD4101 to be a sensor hub for synchronous measurements of photodiodes, biopotential electrodes, resistance, capacitance, and temperature sensors. The multiple operation modes accommodate various sensor measurements, including, but not limited to, photoplethysmography (PPG), electrocardiography (ECG), electrodermal activity (EDA), impedance, capacitance, temperature, gas detection, smoke detection, and aerosol detection for various healthcare, industrial, and consumer applications.

The ADPD4100/ADPD4101 are available in a 3.11 mm × 2.14 mm, 0.4 mm pitch, 33-ball WLCSP and 35-ball WLCSP.

text_intro.text: If you are designing robotics platforms for manufacturing, logistics, or industrial automation, Macnica can help you build an efficient edge AI architecture.

text_1.text: Manufacturing is entering a new era where robotics, machine vision, and AI operate continuously across the factory floor. Building intelligent robots for industrial environments is not just a software problem. It is a system challenge involving perception, real-time decision making, power constraints, and reliable connectivity. Macnica helps robotics developers design edge AI architectures that enable robots and intelligent machines to operate reliably in Smart Factory environments. Using our Capture → Process → Communicate philosophy, we combine advanced sensing, efficient on-device AI processing powered by DeepX, and deterministic communication to enable autonomous robotics at scale.

heading_1.jcr:title: Robotics as the Foundation of the Smart Factory

text_1.text:
Smart factories are built on networks of intelligent machines that continuously monitor, analyze, and optimize industrial operations.

These environments rely heavily on robotics systems, such as:

  • Autonomous mobile robots moving materials
  • Machine vision systems inspecting production lines
  • Intelligent logistics platforms coordinating warehouse operations
  • Robotics systems assisting workers safely on the factory floor

Edge AI plays a critical role in enabling these systems to operate safely and efficiently.

Smart factories rely on AI-powered automation, predictive maintenance, and quality control, where machines continuously analyze their environment and adapt to changing conditions.

image_1.alt: Robotics arm in factory loading AMR

text_1.text:
Factory robots must respond instantly to changing conditions.

That means AI must run inside the robot or machine, not in distant data centers.

Edge AI enables robotics systems to:

  • Process multiple sensors simultaneously: Robots combine cameras, LiDAR, and other sensors to understand their environment.
  • Make real-time decisions: Navigation, obstacle detection, and task coordination require millisecond response times.
  • Operate reliably without cloud dependence: Factories cannot tolerate interruptions caused by connectivity issues.
  • Run within tight power budgets: Battery-powered robots must operate efficiently to maximize uptime.

These requirements make on-device AI processing essential for industrial robotics.

image_1.alt: Robotic arms on factory assembly line - overhead view

heading_1.jcr:title: Capture → Process → Communicate for Smart Factory Robotics

text_intro.text: If you are exploring robotics, intelligent machines, or real-time AI systems that must operate in the physical world, Macnica can help you design an architecture that is efficient, scalable, and deployable.

text_1.text:
Physical AI Starts Where the World Moves.

AI is leaving the data center. The next phase of AI is Physical AI, intelligence embedded directly into machines, robots, and systems that must sense, decide, and act in the real world, in real time. Macnica enables Physical AI systems by combining advanced sensing, efficient on-device AI processing powered by DeepX, and deterministic communication into deployable, production-ready solutions.

Request a Physical AI Strategy Meeting

heading_1.jcr:title: Why Traditional AI Architectures Break Down in the Physical World

text_1.text:
Most AI infrastructure was designed for centralized computing. GPUs, cloud platforms, and data centers excel at training and large-scale analytics, but they struggle when intelligence must operate continuously in the physical world.

Physical AI systems face constraints that cloud-based AI cannot solve:

  • Latency that impacts safety, responsiveness, and autonomy
  • Power and thermal limits inside robots, machines, and edge devices
  • Connectivity gaps and unreliable networks
  • GPU supply constraints and long lead times
  • Rising infrastructure and energy costs

When AI must interact with people, environments, and machines, intelligence cannot depend on distant servers or power-hungry infrastructure.

Physical AI demands a fundamentally different system architecture.

heading_1.jcr:title: The Final Stage of AI Is Physical

text_1.text:
Physical AI is the integration of intelligent models with embodied systems that operate in the real world. It closes the loop between perception, reasoning, and action.

Instead of sending data to the cloud for processing, Physical AI runs inference where action happens, on the device, at the edge, within tight power, latency, and reliability constraints.

In practical terms:

  • AI sees through sensors
  • AI decides using on-device intelligence
  • AI acts through machines and systems

This shift transforms AI from an analytical tool into an operational capability.

image_1.alt: Robotic conference call with hologram display

heading_1.jcr:title: Why Physical AI Needs Intelligence at the Edge

text_1.text:
Physical AI systems cannot wait for the cloud.

They require intelligence that runs locally, predictably, and efficiently, even when connectivity is limited or unavailable.

On-device AI processing enables:

  • Real-time decision-making without network latency
  • Consistent performance within fixed power and thermal envelopes
  • Reduced reliance on constrained GPU supply chains
  • Scalable deployment across fleets of machines

DeepX accelerators are purpose-built for this reality, delivering high-performance AI inference within power budgets suitable for physical systems.

heading_1.jcr:title: DeepX Powers the Processing Layer of Physical AI

text_1.text:
DeepX AI accelerators provide the processing foundation required for Physical AI systems.

Designed for on-device inference, DeepX enables advanced AI models to run efficiently inside robots, machines, and edge platforms where power, heat, and reliability matter most.

Within Macnica’s system architecture, DeepX:

  • Enables real-time inference without cloud dependency
  • Supports sustained operation without thermal throttling
  • Fits product-ready embedded form factors
  • Scales intelligence without scaling infrastructure

DeepX handles the processing challenge, while Macnica ensures the complete Physical AI system is engineered for production.

image_1.alt: Machine eye surveillance in data field

text_1.text:
Physical AI is already reshaping industries where machines must operate autonomously and safely:

  • Robotics and Autonomous Mobile Robots - On-device perception, navigation, and decision-making that enables real-time autonomy
  • Industrial Automation - Vision-based inspection, adaptive control, and predictive maintenance at the edge
  • Smart Mobility and Logistics - Intelligent systems for delivery robots, material handling, and autonomous platforms
  • Machine Vision Systems - High-accuracy analytics without cloud latency or excessive bandwidth usage

In each case, Physical AI depends on efficient, reliable processing embedded directly into the system.

image_1.alt: Robotics arm in fulfillment warehouse with AMRs and boxes

heading_1.jcr:title: Power Is the Real Constraint to AI at Scale

text_1.text:
As AI adoption grows, power availability and infrastructure costs are becoming the dominant limiting factors.

Data center expansion requires years of planning and massive capital investment. Physical systems, by contrast, must operate continuously within strict energy budgets.

By shifting inference to the edge, Physical AI reduces infrastructure load while enabling scalable, sustainable AI deployment.

Physical AI scales intelligence, not power consumption.

title.jcr:title: i-Chips Scaler LSI (Large Scale Integration) Circuits

text_intro.text: Enhance your multimedia devices with i-Chips Scaler LSI - state-of-the-art Large Scale Integration Circuits tailored for superior video quality today.

text_1.text: i-Chips Scaler LSI (Large-Scale Integration), revolutionizes electronic devices by integrating numerous electronic components and functions onto a single chip. This advanced technology enables significant miniaturization and improved performance. In the context of video processing, the term "scaler" refers to the integrated circuit's capability to perform scaling or resizing functions. Found in TVs, monitors, projectors, and video processors, i-Chips Scaler LSIs convert incoming video signals to different resolutions, ensuring compatibility with various display formats. By leveraging sophisticated algorithms and signal processing techniques, i-Chips Scaler LSI large scale integration circuits analyze and modify video signals, upscaling or downscaling them to match the desired resolution or aspect ratio of the display device. Additionally, these chips may undertake additional tasks like deinterlacing, color space conversion, and noise reduction. i-Chips Scaler LSIs help in achieving optimal picture quality and seamless compatibility across different video sources and displays. They empower users to enjoy diverse video formats and resolutions on devices with varying display capabilities, providing an immersive visual experience.

heading_2.jcr:title: Key Features of i-Chips Scaler LSI:

text_2.text:
• High-Quality Image Scaling: State-of-the-art algorithms that deliver superior image scaling capabilities, ensuring remarkable visual fidelity and accuracy
  • Flexible Resolution Support: With support for a wide range of input and output resolutions, integrates with diverse display systems and devices
  • Comprehensive Format Conversion: Equipped with advanced format conversion functionalities, handles conversions between various color spaces, pixel formats, and video standards
  • Image Enhancement and Correction: Edge-blending, color management, uniformity correction, and noise reduction, to optimize image quality and ensure stunning visuals
  • Flexible Image Manipulation: Including rotation, mirroring, flipping, warping, and overlay blending, enabling creative and dynamic visual presentations
  • Embedded CPU and Peripherals: Features an embedded CPU with cache and work RAM, allowing for efficient and flexible system integration. It also includes various peripherals such as Ethernet, USB2.0, and SD Card interfaces, expanding connectivity options
  • Powerful Control and Configuration: User-friendly interface to enabling precise customization and adjustment of image processing parameters
  • Reliable and Efficient Operation: Built with industry-leading reliability and efficiency in mind, i-Chips Scaler LSIs deliver exceptional performance while minimizing power consumption and heat generation.

text_3.text:
The versatile i-Chips Scaler LSI finds applications in various industries and domains, including:

  • Display Systems: Extensively used in high-resolution displays, monitors, televisions, digital signage, video walls, and projection systems to ensure optimal image quality and seamless scaling
  • Video Processing: Video processing systems, enabling format conversion, image enhancement, and manipulation in applications such as video broadcasting, video conferencing, surveillance, and professional video editing
  • Medical Imaging: Medical imaging devices, such as ultrasound machines, X-ray systems, and surgical displays, benefit from the advanced image scaling and manipulation capabilities while enabling precise and accurate visualization of medical data
  • Gaming and Multimedia: Immersive gaming industry and multimedia applications rely on i-Chips Scaler LSIs to deliver high-quality graphics, seamless image scaling, and dynamic visual effects, enhancing the overall gaming and multimedia experience.
  • Industrial Automation: Industrial automation systems, human-machine interfaces, and control panels to enable efficient visualization of data and enhance the user interface for improved usability and productivity

With their exceptional performance, advanced features, and diverse applications, i-Chips Scaler LSIs are the go-to solution for companies and industries seeking top-notch image scaling and manipulation capabilities. Experience the future of visual technology with i-Chips Scaler LSI products.

text_1.text: The IP00C251 is a versatile 4K 3-channel Cross Point Switch LSI designed for efficient high-speed image signal routing. It integrates V-by-One® HS/LVDS Tx and Rx interfaces in a single chip, making it ideal for connecting high-speed image signals among multiple chips, including FPGAs. This Cross Point Switch LSI supports conversion between V-by-One® HS and LVDS, split/select image signals, and overlay/chromakey processing on synchronized 3-channel input images, synthesizing them into one channel. The device handles 4K60Hz input/output on three ports, employs a 3x3 Cross Point Switch for seamless signal routing, and offers genlock synchronization. Its resolution conversion, image correction, and CPU interface enhance flexibility. Operating on 3.3V/2.5V/1.1V, the compact BGA package ensures integration ease. The IP00C251 finds applications in advanced signal routing, FPGA-based systems, and image synthesis for video production and broadcasting.

The IP00C331 is a 4K60Hz up/down scaler that brings a host of impressive capabilities to the table. Designed with a user-friendly interface and advanced features, it is a versatile solution for high-quality 4K video processing.

The support for PQ and HLG HDR systems (10-bit) and the inclusion of a 3DLUT for color management empower users to create visually stunning content with vibrant colors and impressive dynamic range.

The IP00C331 is not only powerful but also designed with efficiency in mind. Its compact form factor, utilizing the high-speed serial V-by-One® HS bus interface with only eight lanes, minimizes the board space required for integration. This makes it an ideal choice for projects where space is a premium, without compromising on performance.

text_intro.text: Unlock superior video scaling with the i-Chips IP00C733A quad input/output 4K scaler. Experience video processing in high-definition like never before.

text_1.text:
The IP00C733A 4K scaler is a highly capable image processing solution with 4 independent image processing channels, each equipped with 4 input ports and 4 output ports operating at 166 MHz. This versatile chip supports various output formats, including Full-HD/WUXGA with a single output and UHDTV/WQXGA or 4K2K@60Hz with multiple outputs.

One of the standout features of the IP00C733A is its advanced picture quality control technology from i-Chips. This technology includes extended-range gamma correction and color uniformity correction, which ensures superior image quality and meets the requirements for higher visual standards.

text_2.text:
With its advanced and versatile overlay function, the IP00C733A is an excellent choice for applications such as video walls, multi-viewers, converters, and digital signage. This function allows for flexible combinations of the 4 input channels, supporting Picture-in-Picture (PiP), Picture-out-Picture (PoP), mirror/flip, and 90-degree rotation. Additionally, the device implements dot-by-dot uniformity correction, specifically designed for OLED and LED displays, further enhancing the visual output.

The IP00C733A offers comprehensive image quality control capabilities, including gamma correction, uniformity correction, color conversion matrix, and bias adjustment. It also provides powerful image manipulation features like 4-channel overlay, alpha blending, and color key blending, as well as mirror/flip/90-degree image rotation.

With regards to connectivity, the IP00C733A supports an 8-bit parallel or 4-wire serial CPU interface and utilizes DDR2-SDRAM external memory for efficient data processing. It also incorporates input/output synchronization features such as frame rate conversion, tearing protection, external force synchronization, and genlock using an external VCXO.

The package includes a 544-pin BGA (Ball Grid Array) with a 1mm pitch, offering a compact size of 27mm x 27mm. The power supply requirements are 3.3V/1.8V/1.2V, ensuring compatibility with various systems.

The IP00C733A is a quad input/output scaler for 4K applications, designed to deliver exceptional image processing performance. Its advanced features and versatile capabilities make it an ideal choice for a wide range of applications, including video walls, multi-viewers, converters, and digital signage, where superior image quality and flexible overlay functionality are crucial.

text_intro.text: Enhance your videos with the IP00C812B Dual De-interlacer/Scaler. Engineered for optimal scaling and de-interlacing, it's ideal for high-end video applications.

text_1.text:
The i-Chips IP00C812B Dual De-interlacer/Scaler is a versatile and high-performance solution for video processing applications. This dual-input/dual-output de-interlacer and scaler combines advanced features with a compact design. With a built-in video decoder, ARM9 CPU, LVDS output, and Ethernet and USB interfaces, the IP00C812B offers exceptional functionality and connectivity.

Supporting a wide range of input formats, including interlaced and progressive up to 1080P/WUXGA/2K1K, the IP00C812B ensures compatibility with various video sources. It features two independent de-interlacer/scaler blocks for superior image quality with full 10-bit internal processing.

text_2.text:
The IP00C812B offers configurability with single-output mode for Picture-in-Picture or Picture-by-Picture, and dual-output mode for separate outputs or driving a 3-D display through its quad-LVDS output port.

Equipped with advanced image processing algorithms like mirror image, 90-degree rotation, keystone correction, and color uniformity control, the IP00C812B delivers exceptional visual enhancements. Its energy-efficient design reduces standby power consumption with separate power blocks for CPU and image processing.

The IP00C812B eliminates the need for additional components to drive a 3-D display, making it a cost-effective solution. It handles image processing tasks for two video channels on the board, reducing board space, programming complexity, and overall costs.

With support for various input and output formats, de-interlacing capabilities, motion adaptive de-interlacer, diagonal line interpolation, noise reduction, and chroma bug cancellation, the IP00C812B provides comprehensive video processing features.

Other notable features include video decoding, PiP and PoP functions, bitmap OSD with embedded font engine, and an embedded ARM926EJ-S CPU with various interfaces. It also offers external CPU interfaces, image quality control, and compatibility with xvYCC.

The IP00C812B supports external DDR3-SDRAM PC800 memory and features a reliable power supply. Packaged in a compact 900-pin BGA, it measures 35mmx35mm with a 1mm pitch.

With its impressive capabilities in de-interlacing, scaling, warping, and edge blending, the i-Chips IP00C812B is the ultimate solution for advanced video processing in multimedia systems, digital signage, broadcasting, and more. Experience superior performance, flexibility, and cost-efficiency with the IP00C812B.

heading_1.jcr:title: Dual Input/Output De-interlacer/Scaler with Warping LSI

text_1.text:
The IP00C813A is an advanced i-Chips product that combines a de-interlacer and scaler into a single device, offering dual-input and dual-output capabilities. It includes a built-in video decoder, ARM9 CPU, LVDS output, and Ethernet/USB interfaces.

This versatile video device supports a wide range of input and output formats, including interlaced and progressive formats up to 1080P/WUXGA/2K1K, accommodating both SD and HD content. With its two independent de-interlacer/scaler blocks, featuring full 10-bit internal processing, the IP00C813A ensures exceptional image quality.

text_2.text:
The IP00C813A can be configured in various ways to meet different application needs. In single-output mode, it enables Picture-in-Picture and Picture-by-Picture output. In dual-output mode, it generates separate outputs at any resolution. Notably, it excels at correcting geometry distortion through a user-programmable "warp table" stored in an external CPU or Flash memory. This enables precise adjustment of image shape and rotation, including 90-degree rotation and mirror image.

Additionally, the IP00C813A addresses color distortion with its powerful brightness and contrast adjustment system. This system is programmable for each 64x64 pixel region in the image, ensuring accurate color reproduction.

The video device's state-of-the-art edge blending function allows for seamless tiling of multiple images, making it ideal for applications such as video walls and large-scale projections. It ensures a smooth transition between blended images, creating a visually stunning and cohesive display.

With its comprehensive features, the IP00C813A caters to diverse requirements in the AV industry, including multimedia presentations, digital signage, video conferencing, and more. It eliminates the need for additional components, making it a cost-effective solution.

text_intro.text: The i-Chips IP00C821 is an advanced picture-in-picture (PiP) processor with dual input capability. Contact Macnica Americas for more details on this product.

text_1.text:
The IP00C821 is an advanced and versatile image processing device designed for high-performance video applications such as projectors and monitors. It combines a 2-channel scaler, de-interlacer cores, and a 1-channel warping and edge-blending engine into a single device, providing enhanced functionality for seamless image transitions.

With dual-input capability, this support processor allows independent enlargement, shrinking, and de-interlacing of images, enabling the generation of Picture-in-Picture (PiP) or Picture-by-Picture (PoP) output images. It incorporates an embedded CPU and various peripherals including LVDS Tx, video decoder, USB, Ethernet, and SD card interfaces, offering comprehensive connectivity options.

text_2.text:
The IP00C821 excels in image control with features like gamma and uniformity correction, ensuring exceptional image quality. The picture-in-picture processor supports a wide range of input formats, including RGB and YUV, and offers output options such as high-speed LVDS interfaces. With an extensive input and output image size capacity, it can handle resolutions of up to 16384 pixels per line with 2048 pixels of horizontal active video.

This device also boasts powerful image manipulation capabilities. The warping functionality enables precise coordinate correction and keystone correction, allowing for image adjustments even at angles up to 45 degrees. Additionally, it supports rotation, mirroring, flipping, overlaying, and alpha blending, providing flexibility in creating captivating visual effects.

Equipped with an ARM926EJ-S equivalent embedded CPU and a variety of peripherals like Ethernet, USB2.0, and SD card interfaces, the IP00C821 offers seamless integration and expanded control options. Its comprehensive feature set includes DMAC, UART, I2C, timers, interruption control, IR remote control, ADC, DAC, and more.

The IP00C821 operates with multiple power supply voltages and is packaged in a compact 684-pin BGA format, making it suitable for space-constrained applications. It fully supports standards like xvYCC and Bt.2020, ensuring compatibility with the latest color technologies.

With its advanced image processing capabilities, the IP00C821 empowers users to achieve superior image quality, seamless transitions, and captivating visual effects in a wide range of high-performance video applications.

title.jcr:title: i-Chips Warping Large Scale System Integration Devices (LSI)

text_intro.text: Explore the details of i-Chips Warping LSI, the cutting-edge Large Scale System Integration (LSI) device, that enables advanced warping & distortion correction.

text_1.text: Warping Large-Scale Integration (LSI) refers to the innovative integration of multiple electronic components and functions onto a single chip, revolutionizing electronic devices. This cutting-edge technology enables significant miniaturization while enhancing overall performance. In the context of video processing, the term "warping" relates to the integrated circuit's ability to manipulate and transform images or video content in real-time. Found in various applications such as projection systems, video walls, virtual reality, and augmented reality devices, Warping LSI solutions provide advanced capabilities to reshape and distort visuals for immersive and interactive experiences. Leveraging sophisticated algorithms and high-speed processing, these large scale system integrations analyze and modify image geometry, enabling precise image warping, perspective correction, and distortion effects. With their powerful capabilities, Warping LSI solutions empower users to create captivating visual displays, virtual environments, and customized projections, revolutionizing the way we perceive and interact with digital content.

heading_2.jcr:title: Key Features of Warping Large Scale System Integration (LSI):

text_2.text:
• Real-time Image Transformation: Advanced algorithms and high-speed processing enable dynamic and on-the-fly image warping and manipulation.
  • Image Geometry Modification: Precise control over image shape, perspective, and distortion effects for creating immersive visual experiences.
  • High-Speed Processing: Efficient processing capabilities to handle real-time image warping with low latency and minimal delay.
  • Seamless Integration: Compatible with various display systems and applications, allowing for seamless integration and customization.
  • Customizable Parameters: User-friendly interfaces for adjusting and fine-tuning warping parameters to achieve desired visual effects.
  • Multi-Channel Support: Capable of handling multiple video channels simultaneously, expanding possibilities for multi-projector setups and large-scale displays.
  • Distortion Correction: Corrects for geometric distortions caused by irregular surfaces or projection angles, ensuring accurate and realistic visuals.
  • Dynamic Projection Mapping: Enables projection mapping onto irregular surfaces, objects, or architectural elements, creating visually stunning and interactive displays.
  • Versatile Applications: Widely applicable in projection systems, video mapping, virtual reality, augmented reality, simulation, and interactive installations.
  • Enhanced Visual Experiences: Transforming ordinary images into extraordinary visual displays, immersing users in captivating and interactive environments.

With their remarkable image warping capabilities and advanced features, Warping LSIs revolutionize visual technologies and applications across multiple industries, opening new possibilities for creative expression, entertainment, and immersive experiences. Experience the future of image transformation and visual manipulation with Warping Large-Scale Integration solutions.

text_intro.text: Optimize your display systems with the i-Chips IP00C788 image signal processor chip. It offers advanced edge-blending and image correction capabilities.

text_1.text: The IP00C788, an affordable yet refined i-Chips solution designed for superior warping and edge-blending. With support for resolutions up to 2K, this image signal processor chip revolutionizes image geometry corrections with its embedded warp table generator. Experience seamless pin-cushion and keystone corrections, delivering high-speed processing for stunning visuals. Elevate picture quality with edge-blending, including white peaking, while the de-interlacing function expands application possibilities, making it ideal for camera input systems. Additionally, this versatile chip doubles as a single input and output scaler. Its compact package enables limitless product designs. Explore the future of immersive visuals with the IP00C788 image signal processor chip.

text_intro.text: 2K120Hz/3D Support Warping/Edge-blending LSI

text_1.text: The IP00C789 by i-Chips is an advanced warping and edge-blending chip designed for high-performance applications. Supporting 120Hz input and output images with resolutions up to 2K, this versatile image signal processor is perfect for a range of display systems, including head mount displays (HMD) for 3D images. With its embedded warp table generator, the IP00C789 delivers precise pin-cushion and keystone correction, ensuring accurate image geometry. The device also features an enhanced edge blending function, utilizing a white-peaking algorithm for superior picture quality. Despite its powerful capabilities, the IP00C789 maintains a compact design, thanks to its efficient use of DDR3 memory. Ideal for a variety of 2K/WUXGA projectors, from pico to high-end models, the IP00C789 offers exceptional performance and stability. With additional functionalities such as image stabilization and advanced image correction features, this image signal processor empowers display systems with seamless and immersive visuals.

text_intro.text: Enhance your 4K applications with the i-Chips IP00C790 image chip. Designed for edge blending, this chip offers advanced image processing features.

text_1.text:
The IP00C790 by i-Chips is an industry-leading LSI designed specifically for 4K warping and edge blending applications. With support for native 4K images up to 4096 x 2160 resolution and 60fps, this image chip sets new standards in image processing.

Featuring single-color processing capability for R, G, or B channels, the IP00C790 offers unparalleled flexibility. For full-color 4K implementation, multiple C790 chips can be utilized. However, the C790 chip simplifies the design process for 4K applications, thanks to its embedded frame memory and direct connection to the C734 front-end scaler via a proprietary interface.

text_2.text:
The IP00C790 also includes advanced image quality control and correction features, such as per-pixel edge blending and uniformity correction, to deliver exceptional image quality.

This powerful image chip opens up exciting possibilities in various industries, including multimedia displays, projection systems, virtual reality, and more.

heading_2.jcr:title: Multi-modal 3D facial recognition for secure, privacy-compliant access control

text_1.text: NAMUGA is a global innovator in advanced camera modules and 3D sensing solutions, delivering ultra-compact, high-performance imaging technologies for some of the world’s most demanding applications. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in South Korea, NAMUGA combines advanced optics, sensing, AI-enabled imaging, and automated manufacturing expertise to help customers accelerate intelligent vision system development.

text_2.text:
Vicon Lite is a vision-powered access control terminal developed by Namuga, drawing on more than 20 years of camera and sensing module expertise. Where conventional access control relies on cards, PINs, or centralized biometric databases, Vicon Lite replaces that model with multi-modal 3D facial recognition, on-device AI processing, and post-quantum encryption, delivering fast, accurate, and privacy-respecting authentication at the door.

Built on Namuga's NEPS platform, Vicon Lite brings together four capabilities that most access control systems treat as separate problems: strong biometric authentication, data sovereignty for the user, quantum-resistant security for data in transit and at rest, and plug-and-play deployment into existing RFID infrastructure. The result is a single compact terminal that handles every access challenge without added complexity or facility downtime.

Macnica Americas is an authorized distributor of Namuga and Vicon Lite in North America, providing customers with local technical support, system integration guidance, and access to Namuga's engineering resources.

text_3.text: Vicon Lite unifies the security, privacy, and deployment requirements that typically require multiple systems into a single compact terminal.

image_2.alt: Namuga Pinocchio dual-lens stereo depth RGB/IR camera banner

text_4.text: Vicon Lite uses stereo RGB and IR cameras to cross-validate depth, skin, and blood flow in real time. Photos, videos, and masks do not pass. The system achieves 99.7% recognition accuracy with a 0.3-second authentication speed, and supports facial vein recognition and gesture-based multi-factor authentication in the Pro model.

heading_6.jcr:title: Post-Quantum Encryption via the NEPS Platform

text_5.text: Every layer of the Vicon Lite system is protected by the NEPS platform: ML-DSA and AES-256 encryption, PUF-based device key enclave for hardware-level protection, and TLS 1.3 for secure communications. This architecture provides protection against both current and emerging cryptographic threats, and is GDPR and CCPA compliant by design.

text_6.text: Biometric data never enters a central server. Vicon Lite uses a Self-Sovereign Identity architecture in which users carry their own encrypted identity. Users can enroll, update, or delete their biometric data at any time, giving individuals direct control over their own credentials. On-device 1:1 matching is the default mode, with 1:N matching available for enterprise deployments.

text_7.text: Vicon Lite integrates with any existing RFID environment in hours. No new wiring, no additional software installation, and zero facility downtime during deployment. A built-in web server handles device management without requiring separate software, and the system supports 1:1, 1:N, and hybrid authentication modes.

heading_9.jcr:title: One Device. Every Access Challenge Solved.

text_8.text: Vicon Lite addresses three categories of access control challenge that traditional systems handle inadequately:

image_3.alt: Namuga Stella180 Solid State On-Device LiDAR banner

text_9.text: From the hardware key enclave to the cloud, every layer of the Vicon Lite system is protected by post-quantum encryption. Identity data in storage and in transit is secured against both present-day attacks and future cryptographic threats, making Vicon Lite future-proof from day one.

text_10.text: A single tap on a smartphone authenticates a user instantly via secure Bluetooth. No setup, no PIN, no physical card. The mobile ID capability leverages secure Bluetooth connection for biometric mobile access, reducing both friction and credential management overhead.

text_11.text: All facial recognition and anomaly detection runs directly on the Vicon Lite device. There is no cloud dependency, no recognition latency from round-trip processing, and no biometric data leaving the premises. The on-device AI also supports anti-tailgating analysis, detecting suspicious access behavior through AI-based behavior analysis.

title.jcr:title: Toppan Products & ToF Solutions - Industrial ToF 3D Image Sensors

text_intro.text: Toppan brings advanced 3D time-of-flight (ToF) sensing solutions to robotics, automation and more. Shop industrial ToF 3D image sensors at Macnica Americas!

text_1.text: Toppan products bring advanced 3D time-of-flight (ToF) sensing technology to robotics, automation, and next-generation devices. Leveraging decades of semiconductor expertise and its patented hybrid ToF™ architecture, Toppan delivers sensors and cameras that combine long-range accuracy, high resolution, and strong ambient light tolerance. Macnica Americas partners with Toppan to make these ToF solutions accessible to OEMs and developers across North America, providing local expertise, design services, and integration support.

text_2.text: hybrid ToF combines the short-pulse type indirect ToF method with multi-time window sensor control technology, achieving strong ambient light tolerance, minimizing motion artifacts, and enabling accurate capture of fast-moving objects even in bright sunlight. Additionally, the industrial ToF 3D image sensor utilizing this technology supports high frame-rate sensing, high dynamic range (HDR) operation, and flexible working range settings to meet user requirements.

heading_4.jcr:title: Key Features of the Toppan Industrial ToF 3D Image Sensor

text_3.text:
• Strong ambient light tolerance (up to 100K lux, Under a sunlight environment)
  • Less motion artifacts and blurs
  • High-speed capture with frame rates up to 120 fps
  • User-friendly configuration enables adjustment of operating working range flexibly

text_4.text: senSPureTM C11U is a 3D ToF camera equipped with “hybrid ToF." It is ideal for using safe autonomous navigation of robots in environments such as indoor spaces near windows or stairs, as well as outdoor areas with high traffic of people and objects that are difficult for 2D LiDAR and conventional 3D cameras.
